candidate_windows.window_text: Our model adoptd 4-layer, 512-dimensional, 8-head transformer encoder layers and decoder layers, and 1-layer forget fusion encoder layer and cascaded fusion decoder layer. The maximum text sequence length and video sequence length are truncated to 800 and 1024, respectively. For training, the proposed models are trained for 50 epochs with a batch size of 8 on 1 NVIDIA Tesla v100 GPU, and we adopt cross-entropy loss and Adam optimizer with the initial learning rate of $1.5\mathrm{e - }4$ .For prediction, we use the beam search with a beam size of 6 and a length penalty as 1. Following Palaskar et al. (2019), the video features are extracted from a ResNeXt-101 3D convolutional neural network, and the dimension is 2048. The vocabulary is constructed based on the How2 dataset, and we do not use pre-trained word embeddings.
